emptyGalleryHint: Register a Service from Console → Kubernetes → a cluster → a Service → Register in Chamber. Needs console:kubernetes and ontology:write.
staleBanner: The Service binding no longer resolves. Update it in settings.
exitFullscreenHint: Click to exit · drag to move
name: Name
settingsGeneralHint: Name and description shown in Chamber. The hosted Service is under Service.
settingsServiceHint: Cluster Service this app proxies to. Changes apply immediately to Run.
settingsServicePathHint: Optional URL prefix before proxied paths (e.g. /app).
deleteHint: Unregisters this app from openKMS. The Kubernetes Service is not deleted.
probe_unreachable: The proxy could not reach the Service. It may be stopped, or its port may have changed.
probe_bindings: The Service binding is incomplete. Open Settings → Service and complete it.
probe_auth: The request was not authorized. Check that you are signed in; the Service may also ask for its own login.
probe_missing: This app is not available. It may have been unregistered, or the Service answers 404 at its own root.
probe_unknown: The status check failed before it got an answer.
probeUnknownSoft: The status check did not finish; the app was loaded anyway.
wsHint: Live features that need a WebSocket are not proxied here — use “Open in a new tab” for those.
readOnlyHint: Changing this app needs the ontology:write permission.
